"The last time England came back to win a FIFA World Cup knockout match from a 0-1 deficit was in the 1966 final against West Germany. In that match, played at Wembley Stadium on July 30, 1966, West Germany took an early lead in the 11th minute with a goal from Helmut Haller. England's Geoff Hurst then equalized, making the score 1-1. England went on to win the match 4-2 after extra time, securing their first and only World Cup title."
